# PySpark column expressions

This page maps 36 PySpark names onto their Batcher spellings, grouped by the class or module they live on. Each row reads in both directions. {doc}`index` explains the statuses and the waves.

To rewrite PySpark code onto these spellings, run the codemod:

```bash
python -m batcher.migrate --from pyspark --to batcher <paths>
```

Replace `<paths>` with the files or directories to rewrite. This direction is implemented. Without `--write` the command prints a diff and changes nothing, and `--write` applies it.

## `Column`

The following table maps the 36 names on `Column`, sorted alphabetically.

|---|---|---|---|
| `alias` | {py:obj}`Expr.alias <batcher.plan.expr_ir.core.Expr.alias>` | canonical |  |
| `asc` | {py:obj}`Dataset.sort <batcher.Dataset.sort>` | mismatch | Differs: Spark asc() sorts nulls first; Batcher ascending sorts nulls last. Pass nulls\_first=True. Wave W0. |
| `asc_nulls_first` | {py:obj}`Dataset.sort <batcher.Dataset.sort>` | canonical |  |
| `asc_nulls_last` | {py:obj}`Dataset.sort <batcher.Dataset.sort>` | canonical |  |
